data.one_liner: Cupertino-style date and time picker widget with separate year, month, and day columns.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cupertino-style date and time picker for Flutter applications. It supports multiple languages and customizable picker themes and modes.
use_when: You need a iOS/Cupertino style date or time picker in your app.
You want a date picker where year, month, and day are separated.
avoid_when: You require Material Design date and time pickers exclusively.
You are not targeting platforms supported by Flutter.
strengths: Supports a large number of internationalization locales.
Customizable themes, title bars, and format options.
weaknesses: Breaking changes in recent major versions require careful configuration of initial datetime values.
